priors = cells('Priors', 'G42:H44')
likelihoods = cells('Likelihoods', 'G410:H412')

pos_dict = {row[0]: row[1] for row in likelihoods}

hypotheses = list(prior_dict.keys())

# Calculate joint probability P(H, positive, negative)
# P(pos, neg | H) = P(pos | H) * P(neg | H) = pos * (1 - pos)
joint_probs = {}
for h in hypotheses:
    pr = prior_dict[h]
    pos = pos_dict[h]
    neg = 1 - pos
    joint_probs[h] = pr * pos * neg

# P(Blue source | positive, negative)
result = joint_probs['Blue source'] / total_evidence
